_G._nv_setMenuWallpaper = function(arg244)
	task.spawn(function()
		local result = tostring(tostring(arg244)):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
		result:match("^%d+$")
		MenuWallpaper.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. result
		local tween4 = TweenService:Create(MenuWallpaper, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { ImageTransparency = 1 })
		tween4:Play()
		local tween5 = TweenService:Create(Dim, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
		tween5:Play()
	end)
end

		writefile("Novoline/layouts.json", json5)
	end,
	save = function()
	end
}
